name: carry persistent state across repeated invocations
definition: Each run reads the current on-disk data files, applies one transaction, and writes back so that later runs compound on prior effects.
failure_mode: If a run reconstructs the initial state rather than reading prior output, the final files diverge.

name: chess legal-move generation covering castling, en-passant, promotion, and mate-in-one detection
definition: Generate legal chess moves including castling rights, en-passant, and promotion, and identify legal moves that deliver mate-in-one.
failure_mode: An off-by-one or missing promotion variant breaks the exact-count match.
